answer: A harbor-master model resists Sybil attacks: every agent must post a refundable bond before docking in the shared market, like a ship paying harbor dues before unloading. The bond stays locked while the agent trades, and proven fraud forfeits it. Faking a thousand identities then costs a thousand bonds - an ocean of capital the attacker must tie up - while one honest agent pays once and earns it back. Each identity also carries a public pigment stain of its past conduct, so a burned identity cannot be quietly repainted and reused.
